en.title: Microsoft Azure App Gateway: CVE-2025-64657 Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
en.summary: Microsoft Azure App Gateway contains an elevation of privilege vulnerability tracked as CVE-2025-64657 with a CVSS score of 9.8.
en.impact: The vulnerability allows for elevation of privilege.
en.fix: The sources do not list fixed versions.
checks: Check Azure App Gateway deployments for exposure to CVE-2025-64657.
